layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Tactical Minimalism. High density data grid. Sharp edges.
layout_and_spacing.container: w-full max-w-7xl mx-auto p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8

grid_structure.wrapper: overflow-x-auto relative w-full border border-[#262626] bg-[#0A0A0A] shadow-2xl
grid_structure.sticky_col: sticky left-0 bg-[#121212] border-r border-[#262626] z-10 font-bold px-2 sm:px-4 py-3 min-w-[80px] sm:min-w-[120px] shadow-[4px_0_12px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]
grid_structure.cell: border-b border-r border-[#262626] p-0 relative min-w-[70px] sm:min-w-[80px]
grid_structure.input: w-full h-full bg-transparent border-none text-center focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#007AFF] focus:outline-none py-3 font-mono text-white text-base sm:text-lg rounded-none transition-colors hover:bg-white/5 placeholder-neutral-800

layout_and_spacing.shadows: use 1px solid strokes or 2px inner glow highlights instead of soft shadows

components.button: Shadcn UI Button. Override radius to rounded-none or rounded-sm. Use sharp edges.
components.input: Shadcn UI Input for Player names in setup. For the grid, use naked inputs flush with cell borders.
components.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

motion_and_interaction.hover: Subtle background lighten (bg-white/5) for grid cells.
motion_and_interaction.focus: High contrast ring focus (ring-2 ring-[#007AFF] inset) to easily see active cell.

app_background.description: Dark tactical abstract background for the main menu to set the elite performance mood.
app_background.placement: Main menu background (use fixed positioning, cover, with heavy black overlay bg-black/80 so text pops).

specific_instructions_for_main_agent: Build a two-screen flow: Setup Screen (Main Menu) and Game Screen (Scoreboard Dashboard).
Setup Screen: Allow adding up to 10 player names dynamically. Show a Start Game button. Use the provided app_background with a heavy bg-black/80 overlay.
Game Screen: Render a grid/table. Column 1 must be the sticky labels: Hourglass, 20, DBL, 19, TPL, 18, 61, 17, 1C, 16, 3C, 15, Bulls eye.
Top Row: Display the player names entered in the Setup screen.
Grid Body: Render text inputs for every cell intersection. Inputs must accept numbers (type='number' or handled as parsed floats/ints). Default to empty.
Total Row: The bottom row must dynamically calculate and display the sum of scores for each player.
Footer Controls: Add 'Clear Scores' button (wipes grid inputs but keeps players) and 'End Game' (returns to Setup screen).
Layout Requirement: The grid wrapper MUST use overflow-x-auto and the first column MUST be sticky (sticky left-0) so users can scroll horizontally if there are many players on mobile.
Aesthetics: Keep it brutal, dark, and highly visible. No rounded corners in the grid. Cell inputs should be seamless.
Data Test IDs: Add data-testid to everything. Examples: 'setup-player-input-X', 'setup-start-btn', 'grid-input-playerX-rowY', 'btn-clear', 'btn-end'.
Font Requirements: DO NOT use Inter or standard sans for the score numbers, use a Monospace font (like IBM Plex Mono or JetBrains Mono) so numbers stack and align cleanly.
Implementation Tech: Use standard HTML <table> for the grid structure as it's the most robust way to handle sticky headers/columns for tabular data, styled with Tailwind classes provided.
